prompt: Design a vacation rental booking app like Airbnb — browse beautiful stays by destination, filter by price and rating, and open a listing to see photos, amenities, guest reviews, and book your stay. Make it feel warm, trustworthy, and modern.
title: Hearthstay

issues.description: The visible SCENES asset is an abstract, token-colored SVG house illustration rather than realistic stay photography. This does not satisfy the brief's photo-first catalog requirement for distinctive, believable homes.

The visible gallery assets are the same abstract scene illustrations used by the catalog rather than a clearly property-specific 4–5 image gallery showing living spaces, bedrooms, exterior, and a local view.

Primary and destructive variants specify hover colors identical to their base colors, and the shared button has no explicit active/pressed state. The universal law requires visible hover and active feedback for every interactive element.
The button radius uses rounded-md rather than the pill-shaped coral primary treatment required by the Hearthstay/Airbnb design language.
Button sizes and radii use raw values such as h-9, h-10, h-11, px-3, px-4, px-6, and rounded-md instead of the theme's spacing and radius variables required by the universal law.
Card and card subcomponents use hardcoded rounded-xl and p-6/pt-0 values rather than the theme radius and section-spacing tokens.
The shared input uses hardcoded h-10, rounded-md, px-3, py-2, pl-9, and spacing values rather than theme rhythm and radius tokens.
The shared select uses hardcoded h-10, rounded-md, px-3, pr-9, and label spacing values rather than the required theme variables.
The gallery uses flat abstract illustrations rather than the realistic, human, photo-first property imagery required by Hearthstay's Airbnb-inspired design language.
The five gallery tiles show visibly different house designs, colors, and scenes, so they do not convincingly read as one property's gallery.
The summary card contains two Reserve buttons, creating a duplicate primary action and violating the single conversion-point requirement.

Several fields are mismatched or nonsensical: Dates displays Apartment, Guests displays 2 guests, Host name displays Oaxaca, Mexico, Verification status displays Loft, and response/cancellation values are bare numbers.
The detail page does not visibly provide the required amenity rows, sleeping arrangements, house rules, cancellation policy explanation, or a clear host identity and verified/Superhost treatment.
The review summary is concatenated into one dense paragraph with multiple guest comments, reducing scanability and making the rating hierarchy unclear.
There is an unusually large empty interval between the primary details/booking area and the reviews section, weakening vertical rhythm and making the page feel unfinished.
All listing cards use abstract geometric illustrations instead of large realistic stay photography, undermining the defining photo-first marketplace experience.
Sunset Terrace Flat appears multiple times in the catalog with different destinations and prices, which reads as duplicated or corrupted listing data rather than a credible browse experience.
Listing cards show ratings but omit review counts and do not consistently expose a host badge or other visible trust signal required by the brief.

reviewResult.summary: The verified implementation has a sensible two-screen rental-app scaffold and domain-appropriate shared controls, but it falls short of the photo-first Hearthstay experience and has repeated token-discipline violations. Button interaction states also do not fully meet the universal accessibility contract, so approval is blocked.
requiredFixes: Replace the abstract SVG house illustrations defined in src/screens/home.jsx and src/screens/detail.jsx with realistic, property-specific photography or detailed scene art that clearly covers the stay card and the detail gallery requirements.
Update src/components/Button.jsx so primary buttons use a pill radius from the theme, have a visibly distinct hover state, and include an active/pressed state.

Update src/components/Button.jsx, src/components/Card.jsx, src/components/Input.jsx, and src/components/Select.jsx to use the theme radius and spacing variables instead of raw Tailwind radius, padding, and height values.
detail: Replace the abstract house illustrations with five realistic photographs of the same Sunset Terrace Flat, covering interior, bedroom, exterior, and local view.

detail: Correct the summary and fact-row data so labels and values match: show selected dates, guest count, nightly price, host identity, verification status, response time, and cancellation policy with meaningful values.
detail: Remove the duplicate outlined Reserve button; keep one clearly dominant Reserve action in the single booking summary card.
detail: Add the missing amenity rows, sleeping arrangements, house rules, cancellation details, and a visible host avatar/status section.
detail: Reformat the review introduction into a structured rating summary and separate review content from the heading; keep reviews as readable divided rows.
home: Replace abstract illustration tiles with realistic, photo-first property imagery and ensure each listing uses imagery appropriate to its own property.
home: Remove repeated Sunset Terrace Flat entries and populate the grid with distinct, specific stays and complete trust metadata including review counts and host badges.
detail: Reduce the large dead space between the booking/details area and reviews while preserving alternating section rhythm and comfortable breathing room.
